| # Object 0x1300 global failsafe command Parameter {#object-0x1300-global-failsafe-command-parameter-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                                                                                              |                                                                                                                                                                        |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

This object determines the support of the GFC.

 

  Index           0x1300
  --------------- -----------------------------------
  Name            Global failsafe command parameter
  Object Code     VAR
  Data Type       UNSIGNED8
  Category        Optional
  Access          rw
  PDO mapping     No
  Value range     See below Value definitions
  Default value   0x00

 

 

Value definitions:

00h: GFC is not valid

01h: GFC is valid
